module: Flowgraph node "Allow Walking" (default category, depends on gameplay_walk). Allows or forbids walking mode, and therefore entering and exiting vehicles. Input pins: flow, allow, deny, set (hidden) and enable (hidden bool, used with set). Output: flow, copy of the input. Calls gameplay_walk.enableToggling.

work.desc: If flow is active: allow enables walking mode, deny disables it, set applies it according to enable. Copies flow to the output.
